Designing and building out a core data layer to power all CBS Sports Digital products, ingesting, processing, and storing data from hundreds of sources over different transports and data stores. Defining a distributed tracing system for web services and data observability within a GraphQL ecosystem. Containerizing core systems to reduce the overhead of infrastructure management. Migration of legacy applications and services to our core data ingestion and GraphQL workflows.Qualifications: What you bring to the teamYou have: 5+ years of experience in data engineering and data system development. Experience in designing, implementing, and maintaining GraphQL schemas, optimizing query performance, and ensuring seamless data retrieval and manipulation for enhanced user experiences. Experience with Javascript/TypeScript, Python, Node.Js. Experience with relational, NoSQL, and key-value data stores such as MySQL, DynamoDB, MongoDB, Redis. Hands-on experience working in a distributed cloud-based environment with high transaction volumes, using a variety of connected services. Proficiency with modern build strategies, continuous integration, unit testing, and automated integration tests (GitHub, issue tracking tools like Jira, and CI/CD related disciplines like GitOps). Ability to design solutions, provide estimates, and evaluate risk and technical feasibility. BS Computer Science, Engineering, a related technical degree, or equivalent professional experience.You might also have: Wundergraph, Cosmo, or Apollo GraphQL experience. AWS Certifications. Experience with extract, transform, load (ETL) pipelines using cloud services and frameworks (a plus). Experience at an online company in digital media or content creation. Ability to work in fast-paced environments and handle high-volume content production. Self-motivated with strong problem-solving abilities and a proactive mindset.

Post ProducerLocation:Remote Position Type:Contract Company:Pocket FMAbout Us At Pocket FM, our mission is to deliver immersive storytelling experiences to a global audience. With a global audience of over 200 million listeners, we are redefining entertainment through episodic audio storytelling across diverse genres. We are seeking a highly organized and creativeCreative Producerto manage and oversee the end-to-end production of high-quality audio content. Role Overview As aCreative Producer, you will play a key role in managing the end-to-end production process of audio content across various formats on Pocket FM. You will collaborate closely with writers, voice artists, creators, and production teams to ensure timely delivery of high-quality episodes. The role requires strong operational management, creative oversight, and the ability to coordinate across multiple stakeholders to deliver compelling audio experiences for our listeners.Key Responsibilities 1. Post Production Operations Management Oversee day-to-day post-production operations for ongoing audio shows and promotional adds, ensuring smooth workflows from raw audio to final delivery. Manage editing, sound design, mixing, and mastering pipelines to meet release schedules. 2. Post Production Team Coordination Work closely with editors, sound designers, mixing engineers, and external post-production vendors to deliver high-quality audio content. Ensure clear briefs, efficient collaboration, and consistency across outputs. 3. Production Planning & Pipeline Management Collaborate with content and production teams to plan post-production schedules, track weekly deliverables, and ensure timely completion of all episodes. Proactively identify and resolve bottlenecks in the pipeline. 4. Stakeholder Collaboration Coordinate with cross-functional teams including Content, Marketing, Product, and Quality Control to align on timelines, creative requirements, and delivery standards. 5. Audio Quality & Finishing Oversight Own the final quality of all audio outputs, including editing precision, sound design, mixing balance, mastering levels, and overall listening experience. Ensure all content meets defined technical and creative benchmarks before release. 6. Vendor & Partner Management Build and manage a network of external studios, freelancers, and post-production partners to support scalable content production. Ensure quality, consistency, and timely delivery across partners. 7. Feedback Integration & Continuous Improvement Monitor listener feedback and internal QC inputs to identify issues related to audio clarity, pacing, sound design, or technical quality. Drive improvements across post-production processes. 8. Process & Workflow Optimization Continuously enhance post-production workflows, tools, and standards to improve efficiency, scalability, and output quality. Document best practices, templates, and guidelines for consistent execution. 9. Volume & Deadline Management Manage high-volume content pipelines across multiple shows, ensuring all deadlines are met without compromising on audio quality or production standards. 10. Quality Control Training & Creative Alignment Continuously train and support QC team members responsible for assigned shows to ensure strong alignment on creative direction, audio quality standards, storytelling expectations, and technical benchmarks. Work closely with QC specialists on a weekly basis to review content, calibrate feedback, identify recurring issues, and maintain consistency across shows and post-production outputs.11. Internal Promotional Video Post-Production Leadership Lead the internal post-production team for promotional video assets, aligning editors, sound designers, and mixers around consistent quality standards, sonic identity, creative style, and delivery expectations. Ensure all promotional videos maintain a cohesive audio language, polished sound design, and production value aligned with brand and marketing objectives. 12. AI-driven Innovations and tool adotion Leverage AI-powered tools and emerging technologies across editing, sound design, voice processing, mixing, mastering, QC, and workflow automation to improve efficiency, scalability, and creative quality. Stay updated on evolving AI trends in post-production and evaluate new tools/workflows that enhance turnaround time, consistency, audio quality, and overall production effectiveness while maintaining strong creative and editorial standards.Qualifications 7+ years of experience in post-production, audio production, or media production, with a strong focus on editing, sound design, and final delivery workflows. Solid understanding of audio storytelling and hands-on experience across post-production stages, including editing, mixing, mastering, and finishing for podcasts or audiobooks. Proven experience working with post-production teams such as editors, sound designers, mixing engineers, or external production vendors. Strong project management and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple post-production pipelines and deadlines simultaneously. Effective stakeholder management and communication skills, with experience collaborating across content, production, and quality teams. Ability to operate in fast-paced, high-volume production environments while maintaining consistent quality standards. Self-driven with strong problem-solving capabilities and a proactive approach to identifying and resolving production challenges.

description:

Are you obsessive about catching what others miss? Do you notice inconsistencies without being told where to look?Do you get satisfaction from identifying errors before they become problems?Final question:when faced with a challenge, do you get excited or run away?If that sounds like you, you may be the perfect fit for ourPaid Ads QArole.At Crisp, we're on a mission to help 10,000 law firms each grow their revenue by $10,000,000 over the next 10 years, creating a $10 billion impact in the legal industry.Our Paid Ads team is responsible for executing paid media campaigns that power our law firm clients' brand awareness and growth across major digital platforms. These campaigns are deployed across hundreds of client accounts and multiple platforms simultaneously.This role exists to ensure those campaigns are executed accurately, consistently, and in alignment with internal standards and client intent.This is a non-client-facing, audit-focused role that requires extreme attention to detail, strong system thinking, and the discipline to identify and document discrepancies with zero tolerance for preventable error.However, it is not a "task-ing" role, or a role where you'll be constantly told what to do - you'll be expected to self-sufficiently spot and correct errors, but most importantly, get ahead of them before even happening, including improving existing systems.** IMPORTANT: TO APPLY ** You will be evaluated and vetted based on your ability to follow instructions: Follow this Willo link (recorded interview platform), and answer the few questions on there, first.Then reply to the ad, stating you've completed the Willo, and we will be in touch.Key Responsibilities Include:Campaign Audit & Validation Audit paid advertising campaigns across Meta, Google Ads, LinkedIn, TikTok, streaming platforms, and others Verify that the correct creative assets, ad copy, and campaign structures are deployed on the correct client accounts Ensure campaigns align with intended funnel stages and approved execution parametersExecution Accuracy & Cross-Account Integrity Identify discrepancies such as: Incorrect assets deployed to the wrong client Mismatched ad copy or campaign configurations Inconsistent implementation across platforms Ensure campaign execution matches internal direction and client-specific setupBudget & Pacing Verification Audit campaign budgets to ensure alignment with approved allocations Identify risks of underdelivery or overspend Validate that budget adjustments and reallocations are executed correctlyTracking, Links & Technical QA Verify accuracy and functionality of: URLs and landing pages UTM parameters and tracking links Pixel and tag implementation (where applicable) Identify gaps in tracking integrity and flag inconsistenciesInstruction Fidelity & Change Validation Compare campaign execution against: Internal strategy direction Client Success Manager requests Campaign updates or pivots Ensure requested changes are implemented accurately and completelyAudit Documentation & Communication Document audit findings clearly, with supporting context and evidence Categorize issues based on severity (e.G., minor discrepancy vs. critical error) Communicate findings in a structured format that enables efficient resolutionAudit Operations (Evolving Scope)This role may operate across a range of audit models depending on business needs, including: Audit Cadence: Pre-launch validation Post-launch verification Ongoing daily, weekly, or periodic audits Audit Coverage: Full account audits Targeted sampling across accounts Audit Depth: Surface-level validation (assets, placements, links) Deeper audits (budget pacing, tracking, structural accuracy) Ownership Scope: Identifying and flagging discrepancies Recommending corrective actions Supporting enforcement of quality standardsOur requirements are pretty straightforward. To qualify you must: Be highly detail-oriented — you catch inconsistencies others miss Think in structured processes, checklists, and systems Be proactive in identifying issues and asking clarifying questions Be comfortable operating with incomplete information and making sound judgments Have strong written communication skills Be tech-savvy and able to learn new platforms quickly Be comfortable working in a fast-paced, high-volume environmentPreferred Experience: Experience auditing or QA-ing digital campaigns (launches, changes, tracking) Familiarity with UTM structures, tracking links, and link verification Experience working with dashboards or reporting tools Experience using project management or task tracking tools (Asana, Monday, etc.)Nice to Have: Salesforce or CRM familiarity Experience with Supermetrics or similar data connectors Familiarity with Google Looker Studio or similar dashboards Experience documenting processes or building SOPs Experience in a fast-paced, multi-client environmentPlatform Exposure (Preferred, Not Required): Meta Ads Manager Google Ads Google Tag Manager (GTM) TikTok Ads LinkedIn Ads TradeDeskWhy Our Work Matters:Lawyers go to law school to learn how to practice law, but law school doesn't teach them how to run a business. In a world where the best cases often go to the best marketers, legal expertise alone isn't enough.That's where Crisp comes in.We partner with committed, growth-minded law firms that care deeply about their teams, clients, and communities. Often, it's a David vs. Goliath scenario, where the most dedicated attorneys lack the resources of their larger competitors.Our work levels the playing field by giving law firms access to world-class marketing execution that helps them stand out, build authority, and grow sustainably.About Crisp: Crisp has been recognized on the Inc. 5000 (Fastest Growing Private Companies in the U.S. – 2024, 2022, 2021, 2020, 2019, 2018, 2017), as well as Atlanta's Top 100 Fastest Growing Private Companies (2025, 2024, 2023, 2022, 2021, 2020, 2019, 2018, 2017, 2016) and Atlanta's Best Places to Work (2024, 2023, 2022).Crisp ( is the nation's fastest-growing law firm growth company. title: Enfermeiro
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Enfermeiro em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Vaga:Enfermeiro(a) — Programa Enfermeiro sem FronteirasSalário: R$14.500,00 (2.500 euros — inicial) + benefíciosLocalidade: Alemanha (Berlim, Munique ou outras cidades com demanda hospitalar — a definir conforme colocação)Programa: Enfermeiro sem Fronteiras, da Sprache&WissenComo funciona? Você participa de um processo seletivo e, se aprovado(a), se inscreve para estudar alemão por até 2 anos na maior escola online de alemão da América Latina, até atingir o nível B2 (final do intermediário). Antes de iniciar seus estudos, você recebe um contrato com garantia de emprego na Alemanha, com cláusulas específicas e seguras — desde que cumpra os requisitos do programa. Se a S&W não conseguir sua colocação após você atingir o B2, o valor investido é devolvido integralmente. Durante todo o período de estudo, você conta com mentoria direcionada da Sprache&Wissen.Quem é a Sprache&Wissen? A Sprache&Wissen (S&W) é uma empresa brasileira fundada por dois irmãos mineiros: um administrador formado pelo CEFET-MG e uma professora de alemão doutora pela UFMG. O grupo educacional administra as marcas Clube de Alemão, Punkify e Vale-idiomas. A S&W é a maior escola online de alemão da América Latina, com a meta de capacitar 100 mil brasileiros até 2030 nos idiomas alemão e inglês. Possui mais de 500 mil seguidores nas redes sociais e satisfação de 98,9%.Principais atividades (na Alemanha): Cuidado direto ao paciente em ambiente hospitalar ou clínico Administração de medicamentos e acompanhamento de tratamentos Documentação clínica e comunicação com equipe multidisciplinar em alemão Participação em plantões conforme escala do empregadorRequisitos: Diploma de Enfermagem (bacharelado) reconhecido no Brasil Idade máxima de 36 anos (requisito do programa de visto alemão) Disponibilidade para estudar alemão por até 2 anos até o nível B2, com flexibilidade de horários Comprometimento com a carga horária do curso e as etapas do programa Documentação em dia para solicitação de visto (passaporte válido ou possibilidade de emitir)Diferenciais: Conhecimento prévio de alemão (qualquer nível) Experiência em UTI, emergência ou centro cirúrgico Experiência internacional ou intercâmbio Inglês intermediário ou avançadoSobre o período de estudos (home office): O curso de alemão é 100% online — você estuda do Brasil enquanto se prepara Mentoria gratuita em grupo durante toda a jornada até o B2 Flexibilidade para conciliar com seu emprego atualEtapas do processo: Inscrição e triagem inicial Entrevista com o time da S&W Aprovação de ficha e documentações Assinatura do contrato com garantia de emprego Matrícula no curso de alemão (até o nível B2) Match com recrutador alemão Colocação profissional na Alemanha

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Software Engineer em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

ContextWe are a fast-growing startup that has experienced tremendous growth over the past few months, achieving 5x revenue growth in the last 12 months and a 10x increase in usage over the same period. As we continue on this upward trajectory, we are expanding our team to support our rapidly scaling infrastructure and ensure we can meet the demands of our ever-growing user base.Mission As a Full-Stack Engineer, you will design, build, and optimize scalable applications. You will own features end-to-end and work closely with stakeholders to take ideas from concept to release, maintain & scale. This role demands a hands-on approach, strong motivation, and a drive to seek the best solutions while maintaining high-quality standards.Key Responsibilities Own Features from 0 to 1: Take complete ownership of features, collaborating with your teammates and stakeholders to define requirements, design solutions, and deliver them to production. Ensure every detail is addressed through to the finish line. Scalable Infrastructure: Collaborate with infrastructure teams to design systems that efficiently handle increasing traffic and usage. Build and Scale Applications: Develop and maintain scalable, high-quality features and applications. Ensure Code Quality by Promoting the adoption of Test-Driven Development (TDD) and maintaining high standards for reliability and maintainability. Integrations Between Frontend and Backend: Design and build systems that simplify and enhance integrations between front-end and back-end applications, enabling seamless communication and efficient data exchange. Support Collaboration: Partner with the support team to diagnose and resolve complex issues, improving tools and processes to enhance the customer experience. Observability and Monitoring: Strengthen our observability by integrating and improving tools that provide insights into application health and performance.Whom Are We looking For We seek a Senior Software Engineer who thrives in high-growth environments and combines technical expertise with relentless motivation. You'll take pride in building scalable systems, owning features end-to-end, and delivering user value.Key Qualifications Node.Js, TypeScript & React Expertise: Extensive experience with NodeJS, TS, & React, leveraging modern development patterns and best practices. Event-Driven Architecture: Proven experience building event-driven systems using tools like message brokers or similar technologies. TDD Focus: Commitment to Test-Driven Development (TDD) and a strong track record of delivering high-quality code. Scalable Applications: Experience designing and maintaining systems that perform under heavy traffic and scale with user demand. Monitoring Tools: Proficiency with observability tools (e.G., Prometheus, Grafana, ELK) for monitoring and maintaining system health. Ownership Mindset: Demonstrated ability to take ownership of features, from initial design through production release. Ultra-motivated and Hands-On: Eager to dive into the code and solve challenging problems with enthusiasm and focus. Seek the Best Solutions: Continuously evaluate and implement the best tools, technologies, and methodologies to solve problems effectively and innovate within the team. Thrives in Chaos: Ability to embrace and adapt to the fast-paced, dynamic environment of a high-scaling startup, maintaining focus and effectiveness amidst ambiguity.Bonus Qualifications Media Processing: Experience with video and audio processing, streaming technologies, or related workloads. AI Integration: Worked with artificial intelligence systems or tools, either integrating AI features into applications or ensuring smooth collaboration with AI-based solutions. Start-Up Experience: Prior experience working at a fast-growing, large-scale startup is a strong plus. Diverse Technical Knowledge: A valuable asset is familiarity with additional programming languages, design patterns, or architectural paradigms.

title: Bookkeeper
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Bookkeeper em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Join Aerial Core - the back office that keeps pace with your ambitionAerial Core is a modern, tech-enabled back-office partner that supports growing businesses through accounting, finance, and people operations services. We've intentionally broken the mold of traditional accounting firms by placing relationships, collaboration, and innovation at the center of how we work. At Aerial Core, we believe accounting should be more than compliance, it should be strategic, insightful, and human-driven. Our people-first culture values trust, independence, and efficiency, empowering every team member to do their best work while helping clients thrive. We're now looking for a tech-savvy, detail-oriented Bookkeeper to join our remote team. Please be informed that this is a contractor position and we will require your CNPJ, this is the perfect opportunity for professionals who value autonomy, flexibility and performance based rewards. You'll work directly with clients, manage their day-to-day financial operations, and leverage technology to deliver accurate, timely, and strategic bookkeeping support. What You'll Do Handle full-cycle bookkeeping for assigned clients, including AP/AR, bank reconciliations, and month-end close. Maintain accurate financial data using QuickBooks or other cloud-based accounting tools. Prepare clear, insightful financial reports that help clients make better decisions. Communicate with clients and team members through Slack, Zoom, and Google Workspace. Use Asana and Everhour to track projects, deliverables, and timelines. Experience working with software engineering teams. title: Sr Ai Engineer - Brazil
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Sr Ai Engineer - Brazil em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Senior AI Engineer PITZ | Remote | Reports to CTOA trillion-dollar industry still runs on phone calls. We're building the intelligence that replaces it. PITZ is the infrastructure layer for the global automotive aftermarket. A mechanic speaks — in Spanish, Portuguese, or English, in a noisy shop — and our system diagnoses the failure, identifies the exact part, selects the supplier, underwrites credit, and executes the order. No screen. No typing. No human in the loop. We're live in Mexico and Brazil. Entering the US this year. And we need someone to build the brain behind all of it. Why this role existsWe're not hiring a cog for an AI team. There is no AI team yet. You'd be the first dedicated AI hire. You'll work directly with the CEO to design and build the entire intelligence layer — voice pipeline, recommendation engine, credit scoring, and the data flywheel that makes everything compound. If you deliver, you become Head of AI within 12 months. Not as a title bump — because you'll have built the thing from scratch and no one will know it better than you. This is a role for someone who's been a Senior ML Engineer or AI Lead somewhere and knows they're ready for more — but hasn't had the chance to prove it because there's always someone above them. Here, there's no one above you. Just the problem and the product.What you'll buildThe voice-to-action pipeline.Mechanic speech in noisy shops → intent extraction → diagnostic prediction → SKU mapping from millions of parts → order execution. Three languages. Regional slang. Background noise. Real world, not a lab. The recommendation engine.Right part, right seller, right price, right delivery. This is where margin lives. Every percentage point of improvement moves real revenue. The credit scoring models.Behavioral underwriting for mechanics with no credit history. Turn operational data — order frequency, payment patterns, voice engagement — into financial signals. The data flywheel.Every interaction makes the system smarter. You design the architecture that turns daily transactions into compounding intelligence. US market integrations.Connect PITZ to Identifix, ALLDATA, OBD platforms, PartsTech, Mitchell1. Adapt models for the US vehicle fleet and English-speaking mechanics.What you bring3-5 years building ML/AI systems in production.Not notebooks. Not demos. Systems that real users interact with daily and that break in interesting ways. NLP or voice experience.You've worked with speech recognition, intent extraction, text classification, or conversational AI. Bonus if it was in noisy, multilingual, or domain-specific environments. Full-stack ML instincts.You can train a model, build the data pipeline, optimize inference, deploy it, and monitor it. You don't wait for a platform team — you are the platform team. Builder mentality.You've worked in startups or fast-moving environments. You ship fast. You make decisions with 70% of the data. You'd rather build something imperfect today than plan something perfect for next quarter. Fluent English required. Spanish or Portuguese strongly preferred.You'll work with mechanics, ops teams, and partners across three countries.Requirements Timezone:Must be available during US/LatAm business hours (UTC-3 to UTC-8). This is a real-time collaboration role, not async. Commitment:This is a full-time, dedicated position. If you're currently juggling multiple roles — this isn't a fit. We need 100%. Travel:Periodic travel to Mexico City and São Paulo. You'll visit workshops, hear mechanics, and see the product in action. If you've never left your desk to watch a user interact with your model — this will change that.What makes this differentAt most companies, a Senior AI Engineer optimizes a model inside a product someone else designed. Here, you design the product. The intelligence layer IS the product. There's no PM handing you a spec. There's no VP of AI telling you the roadmap. You figure out what to build, you build it, and you see it run a real supply chain the next day. You'll work with proprietary data that doesn't exist anywhere else — millions of real mechanic-to-system interactions mapped to parts, orders, payments, and outcomes. Your models get better not because of more compute, but because of more reality. And if you prove you can own this — you lead the team we build around it.

You'll work directly with the owner — closing deals, running daily operations, and keeping the business moving. If you've sold before and have the numbers to prove it, keep reading.Compensation — $1,000 to $1,800/month (USD)Your base is $1,000/month. title: Engenheiro De Ia Generativa - Especialista
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Engenheiro De Ia Generativa - Especialista em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. Descrição da vagaBuscamos uma pessoaEspecialista em IA Generativa, com forte domínio técnico e capacidade de influenciar decisões arquiteturais e estratégicas. Essa posição atua de forma transversal, apoiando a evolução da plataforma de LLMOps e a entrega de soluções de alto impacto para o negócio. Construção e evolução de soluções de IA Generativa que suportam jornadas críticas do banco, integrando modelos, dados e plataformas com alto padrão de engenharia. Foco está em escalar o uso de LLMs de forma segura, governada e sustentável, apoiando produtos, operações e áreas internas. Responsabilidades e atribuições Suas atividades:
- Desenvolver soluções de IA Generativa de ponta a ponta, desde a concepção técnica até a operação em produção.
- Liderar ou apoiar a criação de copilots, automações e assistentes para clientes e áreas internas, garantindo qualidade, segurança e escalabilidade.
- Evoluir a plataforma de LLMOps com foco em governança, rastreabilidade, observabilidade, custo e segurança.
- Atuar de forma integrada com times de arquitetura, engenharia, produto e operações na definição e implementação de soluções com impacto direto no negócio.
- Definir e disseminar boas práticas de CI/CD aplicadas a IA Generativa, em ambientes on-premise e cloud.
- Investigar falhas e incidentes em produção, conduzindo análise de causa raiz e propondo melhorias estruturais.
- Promover boas práticas técnicas, revisão de código, padronização de soluções e compartilhamento de conhecimento entre os times.Perfil esperado:
- Comunicação clara e objetiva com públicos técnicos e não técnicos.
- Capacidade de tomada de decisão técnica ou forte influência como referência no time.
- Habilidade para traduzir demandas de negócio em soluções técnicas viáveis e sustentáveis.
- Postura colaborativa, com senso de ownership e foco em entrega contínua.
- Vivência em ambientes ágeis, com visão de produto e melhoria incremental. Requisitos e qualificações
- Experiência com IA Generativa, LLMs, embeddings e técnicas de NLP.
- Domínio de Python e de bibliotecas e frameworks como LangChain, Transformers ou equivalentes.
- Experiência avançada com arquiteturas de RAG, incluindo técnicas como re-ranking, chunking dinâmico e recuperação sensível a contexto.
- Conhecimento sólido em Git e bancos de dados relacionais e não relacionais.
- Vivência em Ciência de Dados aplicada a dados não estruturados.
- Experiência prática com LLMOps, incluindo pipelines, versionamento, monitoramento, avaliação e controle de custo de modelos.Diferenciais:
- Experiência com modelos open-source como Mistral, LLaMA, Mixtral e Phi.
- Atuação com agentes autônomos ou orquestração de fluxos com LangGraph ou ferramentas similares.
- Conhecimento de protocolos e padrões emergentes como MCP e A2A.

escalate with context and options, not just problems. - Ensure clear communication across teams and leadership with concise updates and action-oriented readouts. - Help standardize how initiatives are tracked in GitHub (e.G., issues, epics, project boards, milestones), driving consistent hygiene and visibility. - Improve team throughput by reducing friction in processes and tooling (templates, workflows, reporting, intake). - Identify opportunities to use AI-enabled workflows to reduce overhead (e.G., release comms drafting, backlog grooming support, automated status summaries, incident triage workflows, documentation acceleration) while maintaining governance and quality. - Partner with engineering and product to implement pragmatic automation that improves delivery efficiency. - Coordinate release plans across teams: readiness checklists, rollout sequencing, communication plans, training/support readiness, and post-launch monitoring. - Ensure operational handoffs and documentation are complete for production support.

PITZ is the infrastructure layer for the global automotive aftermarket. A mechanic speaks — in Spanish, Portuguese, or English, in a noisy shop — and our system diagnoses the failure, identifies the exact part, selects the supplier, underwrites credit, and executes the order. No screen. No typing. No human in the loop. We're live in Mexico and Brazil. Entering the US this year. And we need someone to build the brain behind all of it. Why this role existsWe're not hiring a cog for an AI team. There is no AI team yet. You'd be the first dedicated AI hire. You'll work directly with the CEO to design and build the entire intelligence layer — voice pipeline, recommendation engine, credit scoring, and the data flywheel that makes everything compound. If you deliver, you become Head of AI within 12 months. Not as a title bump — because you'll have built the thing from scratch and no one will know it better than you. This is a role for someone who's been a Senior ML Engineer or AI Lead somewhere and knows they're ready for more — but hasn't had the chance to prove it because there's always someone above them. Here, there's no one above you. Just the problem and the product.What you'll buildThe voice-to-action pipeline.Mechanic speech in noisy shops → intent extraction → diagnostic prediction → SKU mapping from millions of parts → order execution. Three languages. Regional slang. Background noise. Real world, not a lab. The recommendation engine.Right part, right seller, right price, right delivery. This is where margin lives. Every percentage point of improvement moves real revenue. The credit scoring models.Behavioral underwriting for mechanics with no credit history. Turn operational data — order frequency, payment patterns, voice engagement — into financial signals. The data flywheel.Every interaction makes the system smarter. You design the architecture that turns daily transactions into compounding intelligence. US market integrations.Connect PITZ to Identifix, ALLDATA, OBD platforms, PartsTech, Mitchell1. Adapt models for the US vehicle fleet and English-speaking mechanics.What you bring3-5 years building ML/AI systems in production.Not notebooks. Not demos. Systems that real users interact with daily and that break in interesting ways. NLP or voice experience.You've worked with speech recognition, intent extraction, text classification, or conversational AI. Bonus if it was in noisy, multilingual, or domain-specific environments. Full-stack ML instincts.You can train a model, build the data pipeline, optimize inference, deploy it, and monitor it. You don't wait for a platform team — you are the platform team. Builder mentality.You've worked in startups or fast-moving environments. You ship fast. You make decisions with 70% of the data. You'd rather build something imperfect today than plan something perfect for next quarter. Fluent English required. Spanish or Portuguese strongly preferred.You'll work with mechanics, ops teams, and partners across three countries.Requirements Timezone:Must be available during US/LatAm business hours (UTC-3 to UTC-8). This is a real-time collaboration role, not async. Commitment:This is a full-time, dedicated position. If you're currently juggling multiple roles — this isn't a fit. We need 100%. Travel:Periodic travel to Mexico City and São Paulo. You'll visit workshops, hear mechanics, and see the product in action. If you've never left your desk to watch a user interact with your model — this will change that.What makes this differentAt most companies, a Senior AI Engineer optimizes a model inside a product someone else designed. Here, you design the product. The intelligence layer IS the product. There's no PM handing you a spec. There's no VP of AI telling you the roadmap. You figure out what to build, you build it, and you see it run a real supply chain the next day. You'll work with proprietary data that doesn't exist anywhere else — millions of real mechanic-to-system interactions mapped to parts, orders, payments, and outcomes. Your models get better not because of more compute, but because of more reality. And if you prove you can own this — you lead the team we build around it.

title: Senior Backend Engineer (Remote – Brazil)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Backend Engineer (Remote – Brazil) em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. Senior Backend Engineer Hitch — RemoteAbout Hitch Hitch is a white-label specialty lending platform powering Non-QM mortgage products (HELOC, DSCR, HEI) and AI-native origination tools for leading non-bank lenders. We sit between borrowers, lenders, and the systems that move money — Encompass, credit bureaus, AVM vendors, pricing engines, payroll, and banking infrastructure.We treat configuration as a product: one codebase across all clients, dynamic fields, function-based roles. Backend engineers here own real surface area.What You'll Do Design and build services that power loan origination workflows end-to-end — from soft credit pull through pricing, underwriting automation, disclosure delivery, and offer acceptance. Own integrations with critical third-party systems (Encompass LOS, Plaid, Truework, Clear Capital, MeridianLink, OptimalBlue, Documenso, and more). We treat vendor APIs as a first-class engineering concern — retries, idempotency, outage handling, and webhook reconciliation are part of the job. Architect multi-tenant, configuration-driven systems. Every feature should generalize across white-label clients without forking code. Build and operate background jobs and async pipelines (BullMQ) — webhook processing, credit pulls, document generation, SLA monitoring. Set the standard on code quality, testing, and observability. Mentor mid-level engineers and contribute to architecture reviews. Partner with PM and AI teams on shipping AI-assisted features that require reliable, auditable data infrastructure underneath.What You Bring 6+ years building production backend systems in TypeScript/Node.Js. Deep experience with Node.Js: async patterns, event loop, performance considerations, runtime behavior. Strong relational or document database design — we use MongoDB with Prisma;
you should reason confidently about schema design, indexing, and consistency tradeoffs. Hands-on experience with async/queue-based architectures (BullMQ, SQS, Kafka, or equivalent). A track record of reliable third-party integrations: retry strategies, idempotency, vendor outage handling, webhook reconciliation. Comfort operating in compliance-sensitive environments (SOC 2, lending regulations, audit trails). You don't need to be a TRID expert on day one — but you ask\ "what happens if this fails halfway through?\ " Strong written communication for async collaboration across time zones (PRs, design docs, Linear tickets).Nice to Have Experience with tRPC or similar typed API contract patterns. Prior work in mortgage, fintech, lending, or another regulated vertical. Encompass / ICE Mortgage Technology API experience. Experience with multi-tenant SaaS or white-label platforms. Familiarity with Next.Js (we use it for server-side API layers, not UI development in this role). Working knowledge of Redis, Zod, BullMQ, Prisma.Our Backend Stack TypeScript · Node.Js · tRPC · Prisma · MongoDB · Redis · BullMQ · Zod · Docker · AWS S3 · Render · Datadog · Jest · GitHub Actions

title: Senior Backend Engineer (Remote – Brazil)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Backend Engineer (Remote – Brazil) em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. Senior Backend Engineer Hitch — RemoteAbout Hitch Hitch is a white-label specialty lending platform powering Non-QM mortgage products (HELOC, DSCR, HEI) and AI-native origination tools for leading non-bank lenders. We sit between borrowers, lenders, and the systems that move money — Encompass, credit bureaus, AVM vendors, pricing engines, payroll, and banking infrastructure.We treat configuration as a product: one codebase across all clients, dynamic fields, function-based roles. Backend engineers here own real surface area.What You'll Do Design and build services that power loan origination workflows end-to-end — from soft credit pull through pricing, underwriting automation, disclosure delivery, and offer acceptance. Own integrations with critical third-party systems (Encompass LOS, Plaid, Truework, Clear Capital, MeridianLink, OptimalBlue, Documenso, and more). We treat vendor APIs as a first-class engineering concern — retries, idempotency, outage handling, and webhook reconciliation are part of the job. Architect multi-tenant, configuration-driven systems. Every feature should generalize across white-label clients without forking code. Build and operate background jobs and async pipelines (BullMQ) — webhook processing, credit pulls, document generation, SLA monitoring. Set the standard on code quality, testing, and observability. Mentor mid-level engineers and contribute to architecture reviews. Partner with PM and AI teams on shipping AI-assisted features that require reliable, auditable data infrastructure underneath.What You Bring 6+ years building production backend systems in TypeScript/Node.Js. Deep experience with Node.Js: async patterns, event loop, performance considerations, runtime behavior. Strong relational or document database design — we use MongoDB with Prisma;
you should reason confidently about schema design, indexing, and consistency tradeoffs. Hands-on experience with async/queue-based architectures (BullMQ, SQS, Kafka, or equivalent). A track record of reliable third-party integrations: retry strategies, idempotency, vendor outage handling, webhook reconciliation. Comfort operating in compliance-sensitive environments (SOC 2, lending regulations, audit trails). You don't need to be a TRID expert on day one — but you ask\ "what happens if this fails halfway through?\ " Strong written communication for async collaboration across time zones (PRs, design docs, Linear tickets).Nice to Have Experience with tRPC or similar typed API contract patterns. Prior work in mortgage, fintech, lending, or another regulated vertical. Encompass / ICE Mortgage Technology API experience. Experience with multi-tenant SaaS or white-label platforms. Familiarity with Next.Js (we use it for server-side API layers, not UI development in this role). Working knowledge of Redis, Zod, BullMQ, Prisma.Our Backend Stack TypeScript · Node.Js · tRPC · Prisma · MongoDB · Redis · BullMQ · Zod · Docker · AWS S3 · Render · Datadog · Jest · GitHub Actions

title: Senior Backend Engineer (Remote – Brazil)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Backend Engineer (Remote – Brazil) em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. Senior Backend Engineer Hitch — RemoteAbout Hitch Hitch is a white-label specialty lending platform powering Non-QM mortgage products (HELOC, DSCR, HEI) and AI-native origination tools for leading non-bank lenders. We sit between borrowers, lenders, and the systems that move money — Encompass, credit bureaus, AVM vendors, pricing engines, payroll, and banking infrastructure.We treat configuration as a product: one codebase across all clients, dynamic fields, function-based roles. Backend engineers here own real surface area.What You'll Do Design and build services that power loan origination workflows end-to-end — from soft credit pull through pricing, underwriting automation, disclosure delivery, and offer acceptance. Own integrations with critical third-party systems (Encompass LOS, Plaid, Truework, Clear Capital, MeridianLink, OptimalBlue, Documenso, and more). We treat vendor APIs as a first-class engineering concern — retries, idempotency, outage handling, and webhook reconciliation are part of the job. Architect multi-tenant, configuration-driven systems. Every feature should generalize across white-label clients without forking code. Build and operate background jobs and async pipelines (BullMQ) — webhook processing, credit pulls, document generation, SLA monitoring. Set the standard on code quality, testing, and observability. Mentor mid-level engineers and contribute to architecture reviews. Partner with PM and AI teams on shipping AI-assisted features that require reliable, auditable data infrastructure underneath.What You Bring 6+ years building production backend systems in TypeScript/Node.Js. Deep experience with Node.Js: async patterns, event loop, performance considerations, runtime behavior. Strong relational or document database design — we use MongoDB with Prisma;
you should reason confidently about schema design, indexing, and consistency tradeoffs. Hands-on experience with async/queue-based architectures (BullMQ, SQS, Kafka, or equivalent). A track record of reliable third-party integrations: retry strategies, idempotency, vendor outage handling, webhook reconciliation. Comfort operating in compliance-sensitive environments (SOC 2, lending regulations, audit trails). You don't need to be a TRID expert on day one — but you ask\ "what happens if this fails halfway through?\ " Strong written communication for async collaboration across time zones (PRs, design docs, Linear tickets).Nice to Have Experience with tRPC or similar typed API contract patterns. Prior work in mortgage, fintech, lending, or another regulated vertical. Encompass / ICE Mortgage Technology API experience. Experience with multi-tenant SaaS or white-label platforms. Familiarity with Next.Js (we use it for server-side API layers, not UI development in this role). Working knowledge of Redis, Zod, BullMQ, Prisma.Our Backend Stack TypeScript · Node.Js · tRPC · Prisma · MongoDB · Redis · BullMQ · Zod · Docker · AWS S3 · Render · Datadog · Jest · GitHub Actions

Optimize hedging efficiency acrossmultiple liquidity venues including banks, ECNs, OTC desks, and crypto liquidity poolswhere relevant. Develop models fordynamic hedging, inventory risk management, and spread optimization. Monitor risk limits, PnL, and exposure across currency books.Trading Infrastructure & Systems Work closely with engineering and product teams to build and enhanceFX trading and hedging infrastructure, including: Automatedhedging engines Liquidity aggregation systems Smart order routing Pricing and risk management tools Integrate connectivity withbanks, ECNs, and liquidity providersvia APIs or FIX protocols. Improveexecution automation, latency optimization, and real-time exposure monitoring.Market Development Identify and onboardnew liquidity providers and OTC trading partnersacross emerging markets. Build pricing frameworks forilliquid currency pairsand support new corridor launches. Contribute to the development ofscalable FX infrastructuresupporting global payments and settlement flows.Requirements Experience 5–10+ years of FX trading experiencein Emerging Markets. Strong experience tradingAfrican or LATAM currencies, such as: Africa: NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS, EGP LATAM: BRL, MXN, COP, CLP, ARS Experience working at: Global banks EM FX trading firms Payment / fintech companies Crypto exchanges or market makers Proven experience executingOTC and institutional-sized FX trades.Technical Expertise Deep understanding of: FX market microstructure in illiquid markets NDF markets and offshore hedging Capital controls and FX regulatory frameworks Hands-on experience building or optimizing: FX trading systems Hedging engines Liquidity aggregation platforms Familiarity withFIX connectivity, API-based trading systems, and algorithmic execution.Skills Strong quantitative and analytical capabilities. Ability to operate inhigh-volatility and fragmented liquidity environments. Strong network withinEM FX liquidity providers and OTC trading desks. Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills.Preferred Qualifications Experience supportinghigh-volume cross-border payment flows or treasury operations. Experience tradingEM FX through both traditional banks and alternative liquidity sources. Familiarity withstablecoin / crypto liquidity markets in emerging economies. Background inbuilding or scaling FX market-making operations. Strong analytical and problem solving skills Ability to operate across global teams and fast paced environmentsVision & Mission OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a PayFi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain's "killer app," with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors. OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and StableX, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

The ideal candidate will have extensive experience managing illiquid and restricted FX markets, executing OTC and interbank trades, and designing robust hedging and liquidity frameworks to support high-volume cross-border payment flows. Source and maintaindeep liquidity relationships with banks, brokers, and OTC desksacross relevant regions. Executespot, forwards, NDFs, swaps, and OTC tradesto optimize execution quality and manage currency exposure. Monitormarket developments, capital controls, and liquidity dynamicsacross EM FX markets.Hedging Strategy & Risk Management Design and implementFX hedging strategiesto manage corporate or client-driven exposures. Optimize hedging efficiency acrossmultiple liquidity venues including banks, ECNs, OTC desks, and crypto liquidity poolswhere relevant. Develop models fordynamic hedging, inventory risk management, and spread optimization. Monitor risk limits, PnL, and exposure across currency books.Trading Infrastructure & Systems Work closely with engineering and product teams to build and enhanceFX trading and hedging infrastructure, including: Automatedhedging engines Liquidity aggregation systems Smart order routing Pricing and risk management tools Integrate connectivity withbanks, ECNs, and liquidity providersvia APIs or FIX protocols. Improveexecution automation, latency optimization, and real-time exposure monitoring.Market Development Identify and onboardnew liquidity providers and OTC trading partnersacross emerging markets. Build pricing frameworks forilliquid currency pairsand support new corridor launches. Contribute to the development ofscalable FX infrastructuresupporting global payments and settlement flows.Requirements Experience 5–10+ years of FX trading experiencein Emerging Markets. Strong experience tradingAfrican or LATAM currencies, such as: Africa: NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS, EGP LATAM: BRL, MXN, COP, CLP, ARS Experience working at: Global banks EM FX trading firms Payment / fintech companies Crypto exchanges or market makers Proven experience executingOTC and institutional-sized FX trades.Technical Expertise Deep understanding of: FX market microstructure in illiquid markets NDF markets and offshore hedging Capital controls and FX regulatory frameworks Hands-on experience building or optimizing: FX trading systems Hedging engines Liquidity aggregation platforms Familiarity withFIX connectivity, API-based trading systems, and algorithmic execution.Skills Strong quantitative and analytical capabilities. Ability to operate inhigh-volatility and fragmented liquidity environments. Strong network withinEM FX liquidity providers and OTC trading desks. Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills.Preferred Qualifications Experience supportinghigh-volume cross-border payment flows or treasury operations. Experience tradingEM FX through both traditional banks and alternative liquidity sources. Familiarity withstablecoin / crypto liquidity markets in emerging economies. Background inbuilding or scaling FX market-making operations. Strong analytical and problem solving skills Ability to operate across global teams and fast paced environmentsVision & Mission OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a PayFi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain's "killer app," with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors. OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and StableX, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

title: Fx Trader
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Fx Trader em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Role OverviewWe are seeking a highly skilled Emerging Markets FX Trader with deep expertise in African and/or Latin American currencies to join our global trading & liquidity team. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience managing illiquid and restricted FX markets, executing OTC and interbank trades, and designing robust hedging and liquidity frameworks to support high-volume cross-border payment flows. This role requires both strong trading capability and infrastructure expertise, including building and optimizing FX trading systems, hedging engines, and liquidity connectivity with banks, brokers, and OTC counterparties.Key Responsibilities FX Trading & Liquidity Management Manage proprietary and flow-drivenFX trading positions across Emerging Market currencies, with a focus onAfrican (e.G., NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS)orLATAM (e.G., BRL, MXN, COP, ARS)markets. Source and maintaindeep liquidity relationships with banks, brokers, and OTC desksacross relevant regions. Executespot, forwards, NDFs, swaps, and OTC tradesto optimize execution quality and manage currency exposure. Monitormarket developments, capital controls, and liquidity dynamicsacross EM FX markets.Hedging Strategy & Risk Management Design and implementFX hedging strategiesto manage corporate or client-driven exposures. Optimize hedging efficiency acrossmultiple liquidity venues including banks, ECNs, OTC desks, and crypto liquidity poolswhere relevant. Develop models fordynamic hedging, inventory risk management, and spread optimization. Monitor risk limits, PnL, and exposure across currency books.Trading Infrastructure & Systems Work closely with engineering and product teams to build and enhanceFX trading and hedging infrastructure, including: Automatedhedging engines Liquidity aggregation systems Smart order routing Pricing and risk management tools Integrate connectivity withbanks, ECNs, and liquidity providersvia APIs or FIX protocols. Improveexecution automation, latency optimization, and real-time exposure monitoring.Market Development Identify and onboardnew liquidity providers and OTC trading partnersacross emerging markets. Build pricing frameworks forilliquid currency pairsand support new corridor launches. Contribute to the development ofscalable FX infrastructuresupporting global payments and settlement flows.Requirements Experience 5–10+ years of FX trading experiencein Emerging Markets. Strong experience tradingAfrican or LATAM currencies, such as: Africa: NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS, EGP LATAM: BRL, MXN, COP, CLP, ARS Experience working at: Global banks EM FX trading firms Payment / fintech companies Crypto exchanges or market makers Proven experience executingOTC and institutional-sized FX trades.Technical Expertise Deep understanding of: FX market microstructure in illiquid markets NDF markets and offshore hedging Capital controls and FX regulatory frameworks Hands-on experience building or optimizing: FX trading systems Hedging engines Liquidity aggregation platforms Familiarity withFIX connectivity, API-based trading systems, and algorithmic execution.Skills Strong quantitative and analytical capabilities. Ability to operate inhigh-volatility and fragmented liquidity environments. Strong network withinEM FX liquidity providers and OTC trading desks. Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills.Preferred Qualifications Experience supportinghigh-volume cross-border payment flows or treasury operations. Experience tradingEM FX through both traditional banks and alternative liquidity sources. Familiarity withstablecoin / crypto liquidity markets in emerging economies. Background inbuilding or scaling FX market-making operations. Strong analytical and problem solving skills Ability to operate across global teams and fast paced environmentsVision & Mission OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a PayFi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain's "killer app," with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors. OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and StableX, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

title: Senior Oil & Gas Regulatory & Severance Tax Accountant
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Oil & Gas Regulatory & Severance Tax Accountant em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Location: Brazil (100% Remote)Experience Level: Mid to Senior (5+ years) Industry: Oil & Gas (Unconventional Onshore)Role Summary We are seeking a highly analytical Senior Regulatory & Severance Tax Accountant to join our integrated Revenue team. The primary focus of this role is to ensure the integrity of severance tax reporting for Texas and Louisiana operations. You will be responsible for identifying, troubleshooting, and resolving reporting discrepancies that lead to state-issued penalties. This is a technical, hands-on role requiring deep experience in SAP PRA (CA/VL modules) and the ability to bridge the gap between transactional data and state regulatory compliance.Responsibilities Severance Tax Compliance: Lead the end-to-end severance tax reporting process for Texas and Louisiana, ensuring all volumes and values are reported accurately and timely to the respective state agencies. Error Detection & Troubleshooting: Proactively identify reporting errors by comparing state-level data against internal production and valuation records. Utilize the Valuation Control Report (VCR) and specific SAP T-Codes to diagnose root causes of variances. PPA Analysis: Analyze Prior Period Adjustments (PPAs) before posting to understand the ripple effect on the General Ledger (GL), production volumes, and pricing. Ensure all adjustments are justified and accurately reflected in amended filings. Penalty Reduction: Serve as the lead in reducing state-issued penalties through meticulous data validation and the timely filing of amended returns (e.G., Texas G-10/P-5, Louisiana O3). Process Improvement: Troubleshoot systemic process failures and, as needed, document standardized workflows to serve as guides for broader transactional teams. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work as one team with the Revenue Accounting group to ensure that valuation formulas and owner payment setups are consistent with regulatory requirements.Requirements Minimum of 2 years of hands-on experience in the Check Input (CA) and Valuation (VL) modules. Must have experience booking company-operated revenues and navigating sub-ledger details. At least 5+ years of experience, including experience in Upstream Oil & Gas accounting, ideally focused on unconventional, onshore assets. Proven experience with US (ideally Texas and Louisiana )severance tax regulations, including high-cost gas exemptions and state disposition reporting. Ability to perform deep-dive reconciliations across production, revenue, and tax data sets to identify complex transactional errors. Advanced/Fluent English (written and spoken) is required for coordination with US-based stakeholders. A diagnostic mindset - able to look at a reporting error and trace the logic back through the SAP PRA system to the source data. Capable of managing complex reporting deadlines and independent research in a fully remote environment.Technical Requirements ERP:SAP PRA (CA, VL modules), S/4HANA (preferred). Reporting Tools:Advanced Excel (Power Query/Pivot), Power BI, VCR Analysis.

The primary focus of this role is to ensure the integrity of severance tax reporting for Texas and Louisiana operations. You will be responsible for identifying, troubleshooting, and resolving reporting discrepancies that lead to state-issued penalties. This is a technical, hands-on role requiring deep experience in SAP PRA (CA/VL modules) and the ability to bridge the gap between transactional data and state regulatory compliance.Responsibilities Severance Tax Compliance: Lead the end-to-end severance tax reporting process for Texas and Louisiana, ensuring all volumes and values are reported accurately and timely to the respective state agencies. Error Detection & Troubleshooting: Proactively identify reporting errors by comparing state-level data against internal production and valuation records. Utilize the Valuation Control Report (VCR) and specific SAP T-Codes to diagnose root causes of variances. PPA Analysis: Analyze Prior Period Adjustments (PPAs) before posting to understand the ripple effect on the General Ledger (GL), production volumes, and pricing. Ensure all adjustments are justified and accurately reflected in amended filings. Penalty Reduction: Serve as the lead in reducing state-issued penalties through meticulous data validation and the timely filing of amended returns (e.G., Texas G-10/P-5, Louisiana O3). Process Improvement: Troubleshoot systemic process failures and, as needed, document standardized workflows to serve as guides for broader transactional teams. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work as one team with the Revenue Accounting group to ensure that valuation formulas and owner payment setups are consistent with regulatory requirements.Requirements Minimum of 2 years of hands-on experience in the Check Input (CA) and Valuation (VL) modules. Must have experience booking company-operated revenues and navigating sub-ledger details. At least 5+ years of experience, including experience in Upstream Oil & Gas accounting, ideally focused on unconventional, onshore assets. Proven experience with US (ideally Texas and Louisiana )severance tax regulations, including high-cost gas exemptions and state disposition reporting. Ability to perform deep-dive reconciliations across production, revenue, and tax data sets to identify complex transactional errors. Advanced/Fluent English (written and spoken) is required for coordination with US-based stakeholders. A diagnostic mindset - able to look at a reporting error and trace the logic back through the SAP PRA system to the source data. Capable of managing complex reporting deadlines and independent research in a fully remote environment.Technical Requirements ERP:SAP PRA (CA, VL modules), S/4HANA (preferred). Reporting Tools:Advanced Excel (Power Query/Pivot), Power BI, VCR Analysis.

You'll leverage your deep technical expertise and market research experience to drive innovation, mentor junior analysts, and deliver impactful, data-driven recommendations.This is an exciting opportunity for a passionate analytics professional who thrives at the intersection of data science, business strategy, and storytelling, with growing expectations around applied AI and intelligent automation.Responsibilities: Lead the design and implementation of advanced analytical frameworks to address complex business challenges across a variety of industries. Partner with internal teams and clients to translate business objectives into analytical solutions, ensuring alignment with strategic priorities. Design, build, and maintain practical analytics-facing AI-enabled solutions such as analytical agents, automated insights generation, or decision support tools using large language models or similar technologies. Evaluate where AI can responsibly augment analytical work, including data preparation, model development, quality checks, insight synthesis, and delivery, while maintaining methodological rigor. Partner with engineering, analytics, or product teams to operationalize AI-driven analytics in repeatable and scalable ways. Deliver high-impact storytelling and visualization, distilling complex analyses into clear narratives that influence senior stakeholders. Act as a trusted consultant, providing analytic guidance and thought leadership on market research methodologies, data interpretation, and advanced modeling. Mentor and support junior analysts, reviewing outputs, sharing best practices, and fostering a culture of learning and quality. Champion automation, standardization, and innovation, identifying opportunities to optimize workflows and analytical efficiency. Stay current on emerging tools, data science techniques, and market trends to continuously enhance Toluna's analytics capabilities.Your profile: 5+ years of professional experience in data analytics, advanced analytics, or market research roles. Bachelor's or master's degree in data science, statistics, economics, computer science, or a related field. Advanced proficiency in Python, R, SQL, SPSS and/or Sawtooth Strong command of statistical modeling, segmentation, predictive analytics, and experimental design. Proven ability to lead analytical projects from scoping to delivery, including stakeholder management and quality assurance. Excellent communication and storytelling skills, able to translate complex data findings into business implications. Hands-on experience applying AI or machine learning in real-world analytics contexts, beyond academic or purely experimental work. Familiarity with large language models and their practical use in analytics workflows, such as building or supervising AI agents, prompt-driven analysis, or automated insight generation. Strong judgment around model quality, bias, explainability, and appropriate use of AI in client-facing analytical work. Ability to clearly explain AI-driven approaches and limitations to non-technical stakeholders in plain business language. Experience mentoring or leading junior analysts or cross-functional workstreams. Must be fluent in English, with additional languages being a plus.**Please submit your CV in English.Our Values: Acting with Ownership- Demonstrating individual accountability Bringing a forward mindset- Being action-oriented, bold and entrepreneurial Collaborating with Curiosity- Exhibiting teamwork through togetherness Discussing openly, committing jointly- Sharing your views openly Embracing empathy- Being egoless & caringWhat we offer: At Toluna, we're all about creating a welcoming, diverse workplace where everyone can thrive. We offer competitive pay, great benefits, and plenty of opportunities to grow within our global team. Inclusion and respect are at the heart of what we do. Our community connects over 72 million people across 70 countries. If you're passionate about making an impact, we'd love to have you on board.Other Benefits:Healthcare, dental care, life insurance, a meal voucher, a transportation voucher, and a language class subsidy.Join our global team. We welcome big thinking and reward great work.

Our community connects over 72 million people across 70 countries. If you're passionate about making an impact, we'd love to have you on board.Other Benefits:Healthcare, dental care, life insurance, a meal voucher, a transportation voucher, and a language class subsidy.Join our global team. title: Senior Backend Engineer (Remote - Brazil)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Backend Engineer (Remote - Brazil) em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. Senior Backend EngineerHitch — RemoteAbout Hitch Hitch is a white-label specialty lending platform powering Non-QM mortgage products (HELOC, DSCR, HEI) and AI-native origination tools for leading non-bank lenders. We sit between borrowers, lenders, and the systems that move money — Encompass, credit bureaus, AVM vendors, pricing engines, payroll, and banking infrastructure.We treat configuration as a product: one codebase across all clients, dynamic fields, function-based roles. Backend engineers here own real surface area.What You'll Do Design and build services that power loan origination workflows end-to-end — from soft credit pull through pricing, underwriting automation, disclosure delivery, and offer acceptance. Own integrations with critical third-party systems (Encompass LOS, Plaid, Truework, Clear Capital, MeridianLink, OptimalBlue, Documenso, and more). We treat vendor APIs as a first-class engineering concern — retries, idempotency, outage handling, and webhook reconciliation are part of the job. Architect multi-tenant, configuration-driven systems. Every feature should generalize across white-label clients without forking code. Build and operate background jobs and async pipelines (BullMQ) — webhook processing, credit pulls, document generation, SLA monitoring. Set the standard on code quality, testing, and observability. Mentor mid-level engineers and contribute to architecture reviews. Partner with PM and AI teams on shipping AI-assisted features that require reliable, auditable data infrastructure underneath.What You Bring 6+ years building production backend systems in TypeScript/Node.Js. Deep experience with Node.Js: async patterns, event loop, performance considerations, runtime behavior. Strong relational or document database design — we use MongoDB with Prisma;
you should reason confidently about schema design, indexing, and consistency tradeoffs. Hands-on experience with async/queue-based architectures (BullMQ, SQS, Kafka, or equivalent). A track record of reliable third-party integrations: retry strategies, idempotency, vendor outage handling, webhook reconciliation. Comfort operating in compliance-sensitive environments (SOC 2, lending regulations, audit trails). You don't need to be a TRID expert on day one — but you ask\ "what happens if this fails halfway through?\ " Strong written communication for async collaboration across time zones (PRs, design docs, Linear tickets).Nice to Have Experience with tRPC or similar typed API contract patterns. Prior work in mortgage, fintech, lending, or another regulated vertical. Encompass / ICE Mortgage Technology API experience. Experience with multi-tenant SaaS or white-label platforms. Familiarity with Next.Js (we use it for server-side API layers, not UI development in this role). Working knowledge of Redis, Zod, BullMQ, Prisma. Our Backend Stack TypeScript · Node.Js · tRPC · Prisma · MongoDB · Redis · BullMQ · Zod · Docker · AWS S3 · Render · Datadog · Jest · GitHub Actions

Our Backend Stack TypeScript · Node.Js · tRPC · Prisma · MongoDB · Redis · BullMQ · Zod · Docker · AWS S3 · Render · Datadog · Jest · GitHub Actions

description:

About us:Toluna is the global research and insights leader that enables businesses to make smarter, data-driven decisions—faster. For 26 years, we have partnered with the world's leading brands, delivering transformative impact through our advanced technology platform, comprehensive solution portfolio, expansive global first-party panel, and world-class team of leading research experts. You'll leverage your deep technical expertise and market research experience to drive innovation, mentor junior analysts, and deliver impactful, data-driven recommendations.This is an exciting opportunity for a passionate analytics professional who thrives at the intersection of data science, business strategy, and storytelling, with growing expectations around applied AI and intelligent automation.Responsibilities: Lead the design and implementation of advanced analytical frameworks to address complex business challenges across a variety of industries. Partner with internal teams and clients to translate business objectives into analytical solutions, ensuring alignment with strategic priorities. Design, build, and maintain practical analytics-facing AI-enabled solutions such as analytical agents, automated insights generation, or decision support tools using large language models or similar technologies. Evaluate where AI can responsibly augment analytical work, including data preparation, model development, quality checks, insight synthesis, and delivery, while maintaining methodological rigor. Partner with engineering, analytics, or product teams to operationalize AI-driven analytics in repeatable and scalable ways. Deliver high-impact storytelling and visualization, distilling complex analyses into clear narratives that influence senior stakeholders. Act as a trusted consultant, providing analytic guidance and thought leadership on market research methodologies, data interpretation, and advanced modeling. Mentor and support junior analysts, reviewing outputs, sharing best practices, and fostering a culture of learning and quality. Champion automation, standardization, and innovation, identifying opportunities to optimize workflows and analytical efficiency. Stay current on emerging tools, data science techniques, and market trends to continuously enhance Toluna's analytics capabilities.Your profile: 5+ years of professional experience in data analytics, advanced analytics, or market research roles. Bachelor's or master's degree in data science, statistics, economics, computer science, or a related field. Advanced proficiency in Python, R, SQL, SPSS and/or Sawtooth Strong command of statistical modeling, segmentation, predictive analytics, and experimental design. Proven ability to lead analytical projects from scoping to delivery, including stakeholder management and quality assurance. Excellent communication and storytelling skills, able to translate complex data findings into business implications. Hands-on experience applying AI or machine learning in real-world analytics contexts, beyond academic or purely experimental work. Familiarity with large language models and their practical use in analytics workflows, such as building or supervising AI agents, prompt-driven analysis, or automated insight generation. Strong judgment around model quality, bias, explainability, and appropriate use of AI in client-facing analytical work. Ability to clearly explain AI-driven approaches and limitations to non-technical stakeholders in plain business language. Experience mentoring or leading junior analysts or cross-functional workstreams. Must be fluent in English, with additional languages being a plus.**Please submit your CV in English.Our Values: Acting with Ownership- Demonstrating individual accountability Bringing a forward mindset- Being action-oriented, bold and entrepreneurial Collaborating with Curiosity- Exhibiting teamwork through togetherness Discussing openly, committing jointly- Sharing your views openly Embracing empathy- Being egoless & caringWhat we offer: At Toluna, we're all about creating a welcoming, diverse workplace where everyone can thrive. We offer competitive pay, great benefits, and plenty of opportunities to grow within our global team. Inclusion and respect are at the heart of what we do. Our community connects over 72 million people across 70 countries. If you're passionate about making an impact, we'd love to have you on board.Other Benefits:Healthcare, dental care, life insurance, a meal voucher, a transportation voucher, and a language class subsidy.Join our global team. We welcome big thinking and reward great work.

Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde. Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.O diferencial?Aqui você é mais que um professor.Você será parte deuma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas, onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.Estanão é uma vaga CLT, mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, aiicom certeza é o seu lugar.Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas.Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!O que eu faço?Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/asSe você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês. Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano. Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos.Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores.Seja diferente, seja independente
